scopeNote: Covers properties inside the City of Orlando. Unincorporated Orange County and the county's other cities (Winter Park, Apopka, Ocoee and the rest) keep their own permit and code-enforcement records.

violations.coverage: Orlando code-enforcement cases of the housing, lot, zoning, abatement and commercial types, about 147,000 opened 1994 to present. Business-tax, ticket, sign and other case types in the same table are left out. Lags the calendar: on 2026-10-14 the newest case in the table was opened 2026-09-23. 99,433 of the 146,669 case addresses carry two spaces after the house number ('4274  TATUM ST'); the search matches that gap as a run of one to four spaces, or the spacing as typed, and nothing else, so '4274 Tatum St' finds the case.

permits.coverage: Orlando permit applications of every type (building, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, engineering, fire and more), about 1.1 million on record. Lags the calendar: on 2026-10-14 the newest application in the table was processed 2026-09-23. About 5% of permit addresses (55,657 of 1,105,323) carry two or three spaces after the house number; the search matches that gap as a run of one to four spaces, or the spacing as typed, and nothing else, so a typed full address finds them.

source.name: City of Orlando Open Data
source.currentRecordsNote: Code-enforcement cases and permit applications are both published on the City of Orlando's open-data portal. On 2026-10-14 the newest record in both tables was dated 2026-09-23, although the portal reported a same-day refresh. Most code-case addresses carry two spaces after the house number ("4274  TATUM ST"); the search matches that gap as a run of one to four spaces, or the spacing as typed, and nothing else, so a full address ("4274 Tatum St") finds them.
